items.name: doubt-driven-development
items.author: addyosmani
items.description: Subject every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands.
items.summary: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later. --- name: doubt-driven-development description: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later. --- # Doubt-Driven Development ## Overview A confident answer is not a correct one. Long sessions accumulate context that quietly turns assumptions into "facts" without anyone noticing. Doubt-driven development is the discipline of materializing a fresh-context reviewer  -  biased to **disprove**, not approve  -  before any non-trivial output stands.
highlights: Doubt-Driven Development
It introduces or modifies branching logic
It crosses a module or service boundary
It asserts a property the type system or compiler cannot verify (thread safety, idempotence, ordering, invariants)
Its correctness depends on context the future reader cannot see

items.summary: The design-system skill implements token architecture, component specifications, and brand-compliant slide generation for systematic UI work. It defines a three-layer token model flowing primitive raw values into semantic purpose aliases and component-specific tokens, expressed as CSS variables for spacing, typography, and color scales. Scripts generate-tokens.cjs and validate-tokens.cjs produce and audit token usage across codebases, catching hardcoded hex values before they ship. Component spec patterns document default, hover, active, and disabled states with token references rather than raw colors. Tailwind integration maps component tokens into theme configuration while references cover primitive, semantic, and component token files plus states-and-variants. The slide subsystem imports design-tokens.css as single source of truth, uses Chart.js for charts, BM25 search-slides.py for layout recommendations, and CSV decision systems for strategy, typography, color logic, and copy formulas. Slides require var() exclusively, keyboard navigation, centered persuasion-focused content, and slide-token-validator.py compliance checks. Dependencies include brand and ui-styling skills with.
highlights: Three-layer tokens: primitive values, semantic aliases, component-specific CSS variables.
generate-tokens.cjs and validate-tokens.cjs automate token output and hardcoded-value audits.
Component specs cover default, hover, active, and disabled states via token references.
Slide system uses BM25 search, CSV decision tables, Chart.js, and token-only var() styling.
Integrates with brand and ui-styling skills for design-to-code and presentation handoff.

items.summary: Marketing Council convenes a simulated board of legendary marketers whose documented frameworks inform takes on your specific question. Each advisor responds through their known heuristics, disagreements are surfaced, and a synthesized recommendation emerges. Use it for strategy debates, launch plans, positioning, pricing, or when you want multiple expert lenses before executing with copywriting or ads skills.
highlights: Simulated board: Godin, Ogilvy, Schwartz, Dunford, Hormozi, Sharp, and more
Surfaces disagreement between frameworks before recommending direction
Grounded in published positions, labeled clearly as persona simulation

items.name: interface-design
items.author: Dammyjay93
items.description: Create consistent, non-generic interfaces for dashboards, admin panels, SaaS tools, and data-heavy applications.
items.summary: interface-design pushes an agent to build product interfaces with craft and consistency for dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, tools, settings pages, and data-heavy screens. It explicitly excludes marketing design like landing pages and campaigns, redirecting those to a frontend-design skill. The workflow makes the agent state intent first (who the user is, what they must accomplish, how it should feel), name a signature visual direction, and deliberately avoid the generic dashboard patterns that dominate training data. A developer uses it when shipping internal or in-app UI that should feel intentional rather than templated.
highlights: For dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, and data interfaces
Explicitly not for landing pages or marketing sites
Intent-first: who, what, and how it should feel
Fights generic 'AI dashboard' defaults
Signature visual direction over template patterns

items.name: sandbox-next
items.author: cloudflare
items.description: Build new Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next preview with interpreters, AI runners, and lifecycle APIs.
items.summary: Sandbox Next documents the @cloudflare/sandbox@next preview line, recommended for new Cloudflare Sandbox projects on SDK 1.0. It covers code execution, AI runners, interpreters, CI-like jobs, files, mounts, tunnels, and preview URL lifecycle. Use it when starting fresh on @next, not when maintaining stable-only apps.
highlights: @cloudflare/sandbox@next 1.0 preview
AI runners and interpreters
Preview URLs mounts and terminals
Recommended line for new projects

items.name: sandbox-migrate-to-next
items.author: cloudflare
items.description: Port existing Cloudflare Sandbox apps from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to the @next 1.0 preview package.
items.summary: Sandbox Migrate to Next performs the port from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next following Cloudflare's migration guide in order. It is for upgrading existing apps, not starting new projects or day-to-day stable work. Agents fetch linked docs at each step when detailed API differences matter.
highlights: Step-by-step stable to @next port
Links to official migrate guide
Ordered migration checklist
Not for greenfield @next apps

items.name: huashu-nuwa
items.author: alchaincyf
items.description: Instantly turn a person, theme or vague need into a fully runnable cognitive operating system as a Claude skill.
items.summary: Nuwa is a meta-skill for distilling person-specific or topic-specific thinking frameworks into executable Claude Code skills. Takes a person name or topic as input, conducts deep multi-source research through 6 parallel agents analyzing writings, conversations, expression patterns, external views, decisions, and timelines. Outputs a complete SKILL.md with mental models, decision heuristics, expression DNA, and documented limitations. Developers use this to capture and operationalize expert thinking patterns.
highlights: Automatically distills thinking frameworks from people or topics
Multi-phase research pipeline with 6-agent analysis across writings, conversations, and decision patterns
Generates executable skill files with mental models, heuristics, expression DNA, and honest boundaries
